blocks.text: Frequently asked questions

items.question: How do I start earning?
items.answer: Create an account, activate a package, and your daily trading yield begins. Share your referral link to earn bonuses.

items.question: How are withdrawals handled?
items.answer: Withdrawals are auto-approved on submit (min $15) and credited immediately; the on-chain USDT payout is processed shortly after.

items.question: What is the Bonanza engine?
items.answer: Bonanza offers are dynamic, admin-configured rewards — e.g. bring 3 direct referrals to earn $10. They run within a start/end window.

items.question: Is there a minimum package?
items.answer: There is a single one-time $50 package with a 365-day term. You'll see it in your dashboard after registration.

items.question: Do you support light and dark themes?
items.answer: Yes — the platform fully supports both, and your preference is saved to your account.

blocks.text: Privacy Policy
This policy describes how Zeminex Global handles your personal information.
1. Data we collect
We collect the information you provide at registration (name, email, phone), your wallet addresses, and activity logs required to operate the platform.
2. How we use it
To authenticate you, process deposits and withdrawals, compute earnings, send notifications, and comply with legal obligations.
3. Security
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Access is JWT-guarded. Financial operations run inside MongoDB transactions on an immutable ledger.
4. Your rights
You may request access to or deletion of your data. Contact us via the contact page to exercise these rights.

blocks.text: Terms of Service
These terms govern your use of the Zeminex Global platform. By creating an account you agree to them.
1. Eligibility
You must be of legal age in your jurisdiction to participate. You are responsible for any activity under your account.
2. Accounts & security
Keep your credentials secure. We use JWT-based authentication and rate limiting to protect accounts. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access.
3. Packages & earnings
Earnings depend on platform performance and are not guaranteed. Trading yields, bonuses, and rewards are credited per the compensation plan and are subject to change.
4. Withdrawals

Withdrawals are auto-approved on submit (minimum $15) and credited immediately; the on-chain USDT payout is processed shortly after. The platform reserves the right to review, reject, or delay withdrawals per compliance checks.
5. Termination
We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in fraudulent activity.
